name: Gravel
requirements: Side-view strip texture that repeats along a road ribbon: rows from the top = top surface (about 2 px), slab body (about 4 px), shadow skirt (about 20 px). Pixel art, point filtered, tileable horizontally, palette-limited to match the VISTA backgrounds. Also needs a physics hint (grip low/normal/high).
notes: Procedural forge, quality 3.0/5. Physics hint: grip normal-low (loose), bounce 0.0-0.1, slight slide on corners. Import settings still to set in inspector.
licence: own work (procedural; palette sampled from CC0 cairn/downs)

history.note: No CC0 side-view gravel found. Forge by recolouring/dithering dirt body from blaze plains tileset.
